name: set_schema
description: Replace the whole schema with a JSON value.

name: patch_schema
description: Set the value at a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) in the schema, e.g. "/properties/age/minimum". The value is JSON as itself (an object, not its JSON text). The parent must exist (set a missing object whole, e.g. /properties/age to {"type": "integer"}); in an array use an index or "-" to append; "" replaces the whole schema.

name: add_example
description: Add an example document; outcome is pass (should be valid) or fail (should be invalid). It gets the next free id (e1, e2, …).

name: reorder_examples
description: Move an example to a position (0 is first).

name: set_expectation
description: Say whether an example should be valid (pass) or invalid (fail).

name: validation
description: The schema's compile error if any, and for every example: expected outcome, whether it is valid, its status (pass, fail, or invalid when it can't run) and its error count.

name: errors_for
description: The validation errors of one example: instancePath, keyword and message for each.
